about: Maths as the model writes it, delimited or not, mangled or not, and text and code that must stay as it is, with the text each must become. 'tagged' is what repair_reply makes of 'input', with graspy's <latex-inline> and <latex-block> tags and $...$ pairs left alone; the web's processLatex must make the same text with $ and $$ for the tags. 'lesson' is what repair_markdown makes of it when that differs (a lesson's JSON fields also restore doubled backslashes, tag $...$ pairs and keep a list of letters as text); 'replyOnly' cases are not lesson text. 'vocabulary' is the commands, functions, names and environments that bare maths may use; the three implementations must hold the same lists. Read by apps/server/tests/test_math_repair_corpus.py, apps/web/src/lib/latex.test.ts and apps/server/ui/src/shared/latex.test.ts, so the three cannot drift.
